text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. I owe you a lot for
your
assistance last year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'll be counting on you this year as
well.
choice_data_list: Right back at you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This year will present still greater
challenges than
those we have faced so
far.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I trust you are well aware of the lofty
ideals I
aspire toward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you ready for what awaits
us?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, it seems you are indeed prepared.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Triple Tiara.
Let us set our sights on the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, well... You really are something.
choice_data_list: Because the ideal you strive for is my ideal, too.
Because the ideal you strive for is my ideal, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After reaffirming our goals, we take a
little
breather.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You know, considering the season, don't
you
think you're acting a bit too
"business as usual"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look at your office. Not a single New
Year's
decoration in sight.
choice_data_list: Just like usual?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal events provide color and
variety to our
daily lives. If you wish to
have a fulfilling year,
you should pay
them more attention.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Holidays and celebrations are highly
valued at
Tracen Academy. It would be
best for you to
show some holiday spirit
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Surely there's some New Year's tradition
you
enjoy? Go on, name it.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry...
I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just this once, I'll assist you with
whatever activity
you choose. I hope you
realize how rare an
opportunity this is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
New Year's activities, huh? I suppose I
can think
of a few options...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
New Year's activities, huh? I suppose I
can think
of a few options...
choice_data_list: How about setting up a huge New Year's decoration?
I haven't had any ozoni yet.
Should we do some New Year's calligraphy?
Shall we do some New Year's calligraphy?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Visuals are not a bad way to get into the
holiday
spirit. Even if "big" leaves a lot
up to
interpretation...
choice_data_list: How about setting up a huge New Year's decoration?
I haven't had any ozoni yet.
Should we do some New Year's calligraphy?
Shall we do some New Year's calligraphy?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I think the academy has some unused
decorations
lying around. We can liven
things up if we place
them here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come on, then—let's get going. The
decorations
aren't going to grow legs
and walk here
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once all the decorations are in place, I
look
around at our handiwork.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Almost too much so, if I'm being honest.
But yes, I
suppose it's worth a passing
grade.
choice_data_list: Such New Year's vibes...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do you see now how a simple visual
change can
affect one's mood? I'm
feeling ready to give the
year's first
training session my all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. Now there's an idea.
choice_data_list: Then let's get right to our first training session.
Then let's get right to our first training session, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Revitalized, we head off to our training
session
with fresh minds.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You... haven't had any yet?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable... Does this holiday mean
nothing to
you?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The year doesn't begin until you've had
some
mochi soup! We must remedy this
at once.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! Now tell me where you
were born.
We need to make sure we
make you the right
local variant.
choice_data_list: T-That much...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After being thorougly interrogated, I get
to eat
Air Groove's homemade New
Year's mochi soup.
In all honesty, I feel
quite lucky.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad suggestion. Writing our
aspirations for
the year is a good method
to get us motivated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have the necessary materials in the
student
council office. I'll allow you to
use some.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I do this every year with the
student
council. So what are you going
to write?
choice_data_list: Good preparation.
Good preparation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Me too.
choice_data_list: Maybe 'Triple Tiara achieved'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using the brushes and ink Air Groove
brought, we
each write "Win the Triple
Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the messages we write are the
same, Air
Groove's brush strokes are
much bolder and more
beautiful than
mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her penmanship clearly reflects her
character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as we're preparing to begin the
year's first
training session...

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: There she is!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Trainer! We've been waiting
for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Reporters, huh? It appears they've
already
received permission from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to ask some questions
about your
plans for your classic year!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Your fans are atwitter about the
possibility of you
participating in the
Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I take a moment to
respond,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove double-checks with me. Our
plans
have been set, so I nod in
affirmation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let me take this opportunity to make an

announcement. In my classic year, I
intend to
pursue the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
W-wow, the Tiara tour! What a scoop!
Then that
means...

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You'll be running in the Japanese Oaks
too,
right?! Are you aiming to continue
your mother's
legacy?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, I am focusing all of
my efforts
on the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I intend to make my intentions for the
Tiara tour
quite clear through my
performance in that race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, I have a training session to attend
to, so if
you'll excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins Air Groove's classic
year—a fresh
new year filled with hopes
and challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara awaits, and first up is
the Oka
Sho!
